functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support search functionality for 100% of products in the database, allowing customers to find products by name.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a comprehensive search function to ensure customers can find products, which is fundamental to the system's purpose.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate search results for 99.9% of valid product name searches, ensuring that customers find the correct products.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise search results to maintain customer trust and satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results within 500 milliseconds for up to 500 concurrent searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search functionality, requiring timely responses to maintain usability and customer engagement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to process a single search query.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR's focus on handling a potentially large product database and multiple customer searches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a user-friendly search interface, including features like autocomplete and spell-checking, to facilitate easy product searching.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with the search function, which should be intuitive and easy to operate for customers.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for product searches 99.95% of the operational time, ensuring customers can always find products when needed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the product database, necessitating high availability to support customer shopping activities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must protect customer search history and product viewing data using encryption (e.g., HTTPS) during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing customer search data, which is sensitive and requires protection to maintain customer privacy.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support search functionality for doctors based on 100% of specified symptoms and predicted diseases, ensuring comprehensive coverage of user needs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a thorough search function to ensure users can find suitable doctors, which is critical to the system's purpose and user health outcomes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate and relevant doctor suggestions for 99.9% of valid symptom or disease searches, ensuring users receive appropriate healthcare recommendations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and reliable doctor suggestions to maintain user trust and ensure proper healthcare outcomes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return doctor search results within 300 milliseconds for up to 200 concurrent searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search functionality for healthcare services, requiring timely responses to facilitate urgent user needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 50 MB of memory to process a single doctor search query.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability and responsiveness, given the FR's focus on handling multiple user searches and providing timely healthcare recommendations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive search interface for finding doctors, including filters for specialties, locations, and patient reviews, to facilitate informed user decisions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with the search function for critical healthcare decisions, which should be easy to operate and understand for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for doctor searches 99.99% of the operational time, ensuring users can always find healthcare providers when needed, especially in urgent situations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to doctor information, necessitating very high availability to support critical user healthcare needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must protect user health information, including search history and doctor consultation data, using end-to-end encryption (e.g., HTTPS) and complying with relevant healthcare data protection regulations (e.g., HIPAA).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user health data, requiring stringent protection measures to maintain confidentiality and comply with legal standards.
